item.title: OrgRec 0.3.0
item.description:
Dominik Ukolov
OrgRec is a native macOS application for documented pipe-organ field recording. It records multichannel Broadcast Wave audio, retains capture and review evidence, and exports checked research packages. Version 0.3.0 writes Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) 0.5.0 preservation closures and retains exact readers for VAO 0.4.0, 0.3.3, and the historical 0.2 line. The reduced MODAVIS Pipe Organ Dataset (POD) Release 1.5 import contract is implemented; the reduced dataset is not included in this software
